scope: Channel-neutral issuer SDK callbacks with synthetic signing keys; no seller/provider network connection
implementation: Replacement package material can be prepared and retained by a seller adapter for exact retry.

The handoff helper submits the signed cancellation event with its event ID as the idempotency key and validates the exact event ID, revoked status, and response shape before calling replacement delivery.
Replacement delivery receives the signed claim code package and stable claim ID as its idempotency key; the adapter contract requires durable secret-safe storage before external delivery.
Mismatched, absent, or wrong-status acknowledgement fails closed without invoking the delivery callback.

includes: exact signed cancellation acknowledgement precedes replacement delivery
missing, mismatched event ID and wrong status do not deliver
retrying the same retained package reuses stable cancellation and delivery idempotency keys
